title: 2020年9月四级真题 第2套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 The practice of paying children an allowance became popular in America about 100 years ago. Nowadays, American kids on average receive about $800 per year in allowance. But the vast majority of American parents who pay allowance tie it to the completion of housework. Although many parents believe that paying an allowance for completing chores benefits their children, a range of experts expressed concern that tying allowance very closely to chores may not be ideal. In fact, the way chores work in many households worldwide points to another way.

P2 Suniya Luthar, a psychologist, is against paying kids for chores. Luthar is not opposed to giving allowances, but she thinks it's important to establish that chores are done not because they will lead to payment, but because they keep the household running. Luthar's suggested approach to allowance is compatible with that of writer Ron Lieber, who advises that allowances be used as a means of showing children how to save, give, and spend on things they care about. Kids should do chores, he writes, "for the same reason adults do, because the chores need to be done, and not with the expectation of compensation."

P3 This argument has its critics, but considering the way chores are undertaken around the world may change people's thinking. Professor David Lancy of Utah State University has studied how families around the world handle chores. At about 18 months of age, Lancy says, most children become eager to help their parents, and in many cultures, they begin helping with housework at that age. They begin with very simple tasks, but their responsibilities gradually increase. And they do these tasks without payment. Lancy contrasts this with what happens in America. "We deny our children's bids to help until they are 6 or 7 years old," Lancy says, "when many have lost the desire to help and then try to motivate them with payment. The solution to this problem is not to try to use money as an incentive to do housework, but to get children involved in housework much earlier, when they actually want to do it."

questions.q: What do some experts think about paying children for doing chores?
options: It may benefit children in more ways than one.
It may help children learn the worth of labor.
It may not turn out to be the best thing to do.
It may not be accepted by low-income parents.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What do some experts think about paying children for doing chores? 直接问"某 些专家怎么看",指向原文里一处明确观点句,属于客观转述类细节。 51. What do some experts think about paying children for doing chores? A) It may benefit children in more ways than one. B) It may help children learn the worth of labor. C) It may not turn out to be the best thing to do. D) It may not be accepted by low-income parents.

【拆句】题干 What do some experts think about paying children for doing chores? 是一个 wh- 疑问句,主干是 What do some experts think,后接介词短语 about paying children for doing chores 作 think 的对象,paying 是动名词、doing 是动名词作介词 for 的宾语;结 构平铺直叙、无陷阱。

【定位】Although many parents believe that paying an allowance for completing chores benefits their children, a range of experts expressed concern that tying allowance very closely to chores may not be ideal. 尽管许多父母认为按完成家务发零花钱对孩子有益,一批专家却表达了担忧,认为把零花钱与 家务紧密挂钩可能并非理想做法。

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 It may benefit children in more ways than one 说"给孩子付钱做家务在不止一方面对 孩子有益",正是原文 many parents believe that paying an allowance for completing chores benefits their children 中父母的观点,而非专家的观点;父母与专家 在原文里立场相反,这一项把"父母信念"安到了"专家观点"头上。 B) 无中生有 It may help children learn the worth of labor 说付钱能让孩子学到"劳动的价值",原文 从未在专家口中出现 worth of labor 或近义表达,属于凭常识脑补。 C) ✓ 正确 may not be ideal ↔may not turn out to be the best thing to do tying allowance very closely to chores ↔paying children for doing chores 选项 It may not turn out to be the best thing to do 与预判"未必是最好的做法"语义 完全吻合,情态词 may 和否定 not 都对齐,故锁定为答案。 D) 无中生有 It may not be accepted by low-income parents 说低收入父母可能不接受,原文通篇 没有讨论 low-income parents 这一群体,纯属节外生枝。 根据Suniya Luthar的观点,做家务将帮助孩子学会____。 A) 分担家庭责任 B) 认识工作的价值 C) 培养独立精神 D) 自己管理家庭事务

questions.q: According to Suniya Luthar, doing chores will help children learn to ____.
options: share family responsibilities
appreciate the value of work
cultivate the spirit of independence
manage domestic affairs themselves
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 According to Suniya Luthar, doing chores will help children learn to ____. 用 According to + 人名指明出处,要求补全她的观点细节。 52. According to Suniya Luthar, doing chores will help children learn to ____. A) share family responsibilities B) appreciate the value of work C) cultivate the spirit of independence D) manage domestic affairs themselves

【拆句】题干 According to Suniya Luthar, doing chores will help children learn to ____. 主干是 doing chores will help children learn to ____,doing chores 是动名词作主语,help sb. learn to do 是固定结构,空位接动词原形;结构平铺直叙、无陷阱。

【定位】Luthar is not opposed to giving allowances, but she thinks it's important to establish that chores are done not because they will lead to payment, but because they keep the household running. Luthar 并不反对给零花钱,但她认为重要的是要明确:做家务不是因为家务会带来报酬,而是因 为家务能让家庭正常运转。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 they keep the household running ↔share family responsibilities 选项 share family responsibilities 与预判"为家庭运转分担一份力"的语义吻合,核心都 是"为家庭"而非"为钱"或"为自身"。 B) 无中生有 appreciate the value of work 与 Q51 中的 learn the worth of labor 几乎同款,都是原 文未出现的"劳动价值"口号,Luthar 强调的是"为家庭运转"而非"劳动的价值"。 C) 偷换概念 cultivate the spirit of independence(培养独立精神)是常见的家务教育口号,但 Luthar 通篇没有谈 independence,她谈的是 household running(家庭运转),把焦点从"家庭"挪 到了"个人独立"。 D) 过度推断 manage domestic affairs themselves 说孩子自己"管家务",反身代词 themselves 强 调"独自",原文只说让家庭运转,从未要求孩子独立"打理家务",且年龄段也对不上。 Ron Lieber认为给孩子零花钱的目标应该是什么? A) 帮助加强家庭纽带。 B) 教他们如何管理金钱。 C) 激励他们做更多家务。 D) 表达父母对他们帮助的感激。

questions.q: What does Ron Lieber think should be the goal of giving children allowances?
options: To help to strengthen family ties.
To teach them how to manage money.
To motivate them to do more housework.
To show parents' appreciation of their help.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does Ron Lieber think should be the goal of giving children allowances? 直接问 Lieber 认为发零花钱的目的是什么,原文必有对应观点。

【拆句】题干 What does Ron Lieber think should be the goal of giving children allowances? 是宾语从句嵌入疑问句的结构:What 实际是宾语从句 What should be the goal of giving children allowances 中的主语,Ron Lieber think 是插入语,giving children allowances 是 动名词短语作 of 的宾语;结构稍复杂但无陷阱。 53. What does Ron Lieber think should be the goal of giving children allowances? A) To help to strengthen family ties. B) To teach them how to manage money. C) To motivate them to do more housework. D) To show parents' appreciation of their help.

【定位】Luthar's suggested approach to allowance is compatible with that of writer Ron Lieber, who advises that allowances be used as a means of showing children how to save, give, and spend on things they care about. Luthar 的零花钱主张与作家 Ron Lieber 的主张一致,Lieber 建议把零花钱用作教孩子如何 储蓄、给予以及在他们在意的事情上花钱的手段。

【选项】A) 无中生有 To help to strengthen family ties 说零花钱能加强家庭纽带,family ties(家庭纽带)在原 文中无任何对应表述。 B) ✓ 正确 showing children how to save, give, and spend on things they care about ↔ To teach them how to manage money 选项 To teach them how to manage money 把 save/give/spend 三者上位化为 manage money,与预判"教孩子理财"完全吻合。 C) 与原文相反 To motivate them to do more housework 说零花钱用来"激励孩子多做家务",正是 Lieber 与 Luthar 共同反对的观点(原文末引文 not with the expectation of compensation),把他立场完全反转。 D) 偷换概念 To show parents' appreciation of their help 说零花钱是为表达父母对孩子帮助的感 谢,Lieber 谈的是"教孩子"而非"父母表达感激",方向完全错位。 David Lancy对18个月大的孩子有什么看法? A) 他们有帮助做家务的天生本能。 B) 他们太小了,不应该为自己做的事要钱。 C) 他们应该学会理解家庭责任。 D) 他们需要一点激励才能参与家务劳动。

questions.q: What does David Lancy say about 18-month-olds?
options: They have a natural instinct to help around the house.
They are too young to request money for what they do.
They should learn to understand family responsibilities.
They need a little incentive to get involved in housework.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does David Lancy say about 18-month-olds? 直接问 Lancy 关于 18 个月孩 子说了什么,原文必有出处。

【拆句】题干 What does David Lancy say about 18-month-olds? 是 wh- 疑问句,主干是 What does David Lancy say,about 18-month-olds 是介词短语作 say 的对象状语,18-month- olds 是带连字符的复合名词,意为"18 个月大的孩子";结构平铺直叙。 54. What does David Lancy say about 18-month-olds? A) They have a natural instinct to help around the house. B) They are too young to request money for what they do. C) They should learn to understand family responsibilities. D) They need a little incentive to get involved in housework.

【定位】At about 18 months of age, Lancy says, most children become eager to help their parents, and in many cultures, they begin helping with housework at that age. Lancy 说,大约 18 个月大时,大多数孩子就变得渴望帮父母,在许多文化中,他们就是从这个年 龄开始参与家务的。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 become eager to help their parents ↔have a natural instinct to help around the house 选项 They have a natural instinct to help around the house 与预判"自发想帮父母做 家务"完全吻合,natural instinct 把 eager 的强度感与自发性都吃下来了。 B) 无中生有 They are too young to request money for what they do 说他们太小不会要钱,too young to 是"太……以至于不能"结构,原文从未谈 18 个月孩子是否"要钱",纯属脑补。 C) 偷换概念 They should learn to understand family responsibilities 用 should 提出应然主张,但 原文 Lancy 是在描述 18 个月孩子"已经渴望帮忙"这一事实,而非主张他们"应该去理解家 庭责任";动作主体也被悄悄换成了"教孩子去理解"。 D) 与原文相反 They need a little incentive to get involved in housework 说他们需要"一点激励"才 参与家务,这恰是 Lancy 反对的观点;原文明确说他们 become eager to help,根本不需 要外在 incentive,而文末 Lancy 又直接说 not to try to use money as an incentive。 David Lancy建议美国家长做什么? A) 在做家务方面为孩子树立好榜样。 B) 让孩子无偿做家务。 C) 教孩子如何做家务。 D) 接受孩子早期的帮忙意愿。

questions.q: What does David Lancy advise American parents to do?
options: Set a good example for children in doing housework.
Make children do housework without compensation.
Teach children how to do housework.
Accept children's early bids to help.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does David Lancy advise American parents to do? 问 Lancy 给美国父母的 建议,原文末尾必有明示建议句。

【拆句】题干 What does David Lancy advise American parents to do? 是 wh- 疑问句,主干是 What does David Lancy advise,advise sb. to do sth. 是固定结构,American parents 是 advise 的宾语,to do 是不定式作宾补;What 实指 to do 后省去的动词宾语;结构平铺直叙。

【定位】The solution to this problem is not to try to use money as an incentive to do housework, but to get children involved in housework much earlier, when they actually want to do it. 对这个问题的解决办法,不是用钱当作做家务的激励,而是让孩子在他们真的想做家务的更早 年龄就参与进来。 55. What does David Lancy advise American parents to do? A) Set a good example for children in doing housework. B) Make children do housework without compensation. C) Teach children how to do housework. D) Accept children's early bids to help.

【选项】A) 无中生有 Set a good example for children in doing housework 说父母要做榜样,原文从未谈 set a good example/role model 类内容,Lancy 谈的是"时机"而非"示范"。 B) 以偏概全 Make children do housework without compensation 说要让孩子无偿做家 务;without compensation 虽呼应了 Lieber 的 not with the expectation of compensation,但 Lancy 的核心建议不是"无偿",而是"趁早"(timing),把重点偏移到了"是 否给钱"上。 C) 偷换概念 Teach children how to do housework 说教孩子"怎么做家务"的技能,原文重点是"何时 让他们做"(timing)而非"如何教他们做"(skill);两者方向不同。 D) ✓ 正确 We deny our children's bids to help ↔Accept children's early bids to help get children involved in housework much earlier, when they actually want to do it ↔ Accept children's early bids to help 选项 Accept children's early bids to help 把 deny → accept 反义对换,early、bids to help 原词保留,与预判"趁早接住孩子主动"完全吻合。
